title: Complex purchase orders to ERP data
purpose: Evaluate whether the GAIK Solution Configuration Wizard captures the fixed purchase-order scenario, chooses and configures a valid layout-aware GAIK solution, generates a valid solution package, and produces an executable PoC.

protocol.output_directory_policy: Write the wizard output to the run-specific generated_package directory, or copy the complete unmodified output there after the run. No absolute path is stored in run metadata.
protocol.confirmation_policy: At every routine confirmation before original PoC execution, answer Yes and proceed without changes.
protocol.unexpected_question_answer: Not specified for this evaluation. If a value is required, record it as an explicit assumption for user confirmation.
protocol.po_c_policy: Execute the original wizard-generated PoC without editing its source files. Environment variables and credentials may be supplied externally. EQ4 is permanently based on this original execution.

recovery_policy.trigger: The original PoC does not execute successfully.
recovery_policy.feedback_scope: Return recorded execution evidence to the wizard without adding corrective code or new requirements.
recovery_policy.stopping_rule: Stop after the first successful execution or after the third unsuccessful refinement.

reported_values.1-3: PoC executed successfully after the stated number of refinement attempts.
reported_values.N/A: PoC never executed successfully after three refinement attempts.

expected_component.name: VisionExtractor
expected_component.selection_reason: The frozen registry directs accuracy-critical complex layouts to VisionExtractor rather than DocumentsToStructuredData.

EQ1.parameter: Target schema structure, types, and formats

EQ1.oracle_value: Order-processing employees use a web application to upload one or more purchase-order PDFs. The system extracts a structured record for each purchase order and provides the original document, extracted values, and confidence or uncertainty information for review. The employee or reviewer can correct and approve the record. The application provides an ERP-compatible downloadable JSON file for each approved purchase order. Only approved data may proceed to ERP.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: The employee-facing workflow includes web-based upload of one or more purchase orders, extraction and review, correction and approval, and downloadable JSON output before ERP transfer.

EQ1.parameter: Security, access, audit, and evaluation scope
EQ1.oracle_value: External APIs allowed; no retained input duplicate; approved JSON and decision may be retained; production authentication, RBAC, ERP credentials, and full audit logging are outside scope; fixture acceptance requires successful execution, JSON parsing, three-item preservation, and no unsupported values.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: Security boundaries and the complete PoC acceptance scope are documented.

EQ2.accepted_semantics: Purchase-order extraction is classified as knowledge capture.
The primary executable extraction asset is VisionExtractor because the purchase orders are layout-complex and accuracy-critical.
source: GAIK registry known limitations and best_for

EQ2.oracle_value: VisionExtractor processes the original PDF/image content directly; no text-only parser is relied on for the scored fixture.
EQ2.accepted_semantics: The PDF is passed directly to a layout-aware vision extractor that can retain cross-page context.
Field-level confidence scores and reasons are enabled for reviewer support.

EQ2.oracle_value: VisionExtractor has a task and schema/requirements assets defining PurchaseOrderERPRecord and its nested line items.
EQ2.accepted_semantics: The required task parameter and reusable nested extraction schema are connected to the extraction step.

EQ2.oracle_value: The PoC invokes VisionExtractor once and does not also execute DocumentsToStructuredData or a separate MultimodalParser-to-Extractor pipeline over the same input.
EQ2.accepted_semantics: There is one authoritative layout-aware extraction path, while references for explanation or traceability are allowed.

EQ2.oracle_value: Human review follows structured extraction and precedes ERP transfer.
EQ2.accepted_semantics: The workflow gates downstream ERP use on review approval.

EQ2.oracle_value: Reviewer receives the structured record, field-level confidence or uncertainty information, and original purchase-order PDF.
EQ2.accepted_semantics: All required evidence is available at the review step.

EQ2.oracle_value: CLI accepts a PDF and saves JSON; live ERP API/database integration is not required.
EQ2.accepted_semantics: The executable PoC has the requested local CLI and JSON boundary.

EQ4.oracle_value: For the original unmodified PoC, the declared setup or import command completes with exit code 0.
The original unmodified generated PoC processes purchase_order_complex.pdf and exits with code 0.
The original unmodified PoC generates a new non-empty JSON ERP record that parses successfully.

The original unmodified PoC output preserves the expected header facts and all three line items in expected_erp_record.json, including the cross-page item, exact identifiers and units, and no unsupported values.

EQ1.formula: Yes verdicts for EQ1-R rows / total EQ1-R rows

EQ2.formula: Yes verdicts for EQ2-C rows / total EQ2-C rows

EQ3.formula: A run passes only if every mandatory EQ3-P check is Yes; passed runs / 2

EQ4.formula: A run passes only if every mandatory EQ4-X check for the original unmodified PoC is Yes; passed runs / 2

recovery_diagnostic.formula: Record the first successful execution: 0 for original success, 1-3 for success after that many refinements, and N/A when all three refinements fail.
recovery_diagnostic.reporting: Report initially successful runs, runs recovered within three refinements, and runs that never executed successfully.

scoring.two_run_aggregation: For EQ1 and EQ2, pool Yes verdicts across both runs and divide by the pooled number of scored checks. For EQ3 and EQ4, divide the number of passing runs by two.

verdict_policy.semantic_matching: The LLM may align semantically equivalent wording and identify evidence, but it must not enter the final verdict. The evaluator reviews the side-by-side evidence and enters Yes or No.
verdict_policy.missing_requirement: If an oracle requirement is absent, the generated-value cell states NOT FOUND, the evidence cell lists the searched sources/paths, and the evaluator enters No. This keeps omitted requirements in the denominator.
verdict_policy.evidence_rule: Every verdict cell must have adjacent evidence that identifies the source file and a concrete excerpt, path, command result, or parser/validator result.
